newsitem.title: SWITZERLAND: SPECTOR IN PARTNERSHIP WITH KODAK.
newsitem.headline: SPECTOR IN PARTNERSHIP WITH KODAK.

text.p: Belgium's Spector Photo Group NV, in Zurich to announce details of an acquisition and capital rise, said it last week completed a long-term partnership agreement with Eastman Kodak Co. of the U.S.
"All the retail know-how of Kodak in the field of digital solutions will be applied in the new Europe-wide retail network of Spector," the company said in a statement released in Zurich.

Spector has acquired Interdiscount France from Swiss Distefora, previously known as Interdiscount Holding , and said today that it would close in the coming days the previously announced acquisition of a controlling interest in Porst Holding and the indirect acquisition of 100 percent of Photo Hall in Belgium.

Spector said the strategic moves were aimed at transforming it from a European photo finishing marketing group with a turnover of eight billion Belgian francs to a retail oriented photo marketing group with a turnover of about 29 billion Belgian francs.
Spector said these acquisitions would be followed by a restructuring of its shareholder structure and a complete legal restructuring of its operations of Porst Holding under Spector.
